Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 begin
 select nvl(nursing_flag,'N')
 into :GLOBAL.chapter_nursing_flag
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 v_local_date between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,v_local_date+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_nursing_audit_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_nursing_audit_reqd VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(9);
 temp_contract_type VARCHAR2(2);
 temp_catalog_number varchar2(10);
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_count_utr number;
 temp_count_utb number;
 temp_qc_label_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 nBags NUMBER:=0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id
 from utrs
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id and
 test_chapter_id = :test_chapter_id and
 test_id = 'ABORH' and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 cancel_flag is null
 order by unit_id;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := c1_rec.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := 
 chk_digit_query ( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,:ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id) ;
 --
 -- Check for Donor Interface
 --
 begin
 select decode(donor_lab_dats,null,'N','Y'),
 component_review_flag,
 nvl(nursing_audit_flag,'N'),
 contract_id,
 qc_label_flag,
 catalog_number,
 nvl(add_on_bags,0) ---to_number(substr(bag_code,-1))+nvl(add_on_bags,0)
 into :donor_interface,
 :component_review,
 temp_nursing_audit_flag,
 temp_contract_id,
 temp_qc_label_flag,
 temp_catalog_number, 
 temp_no_of_bags
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :CTRL_BLK_2.chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =trunc( :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) ;
 EXCEPTION 
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 --
 -- Make sure that unit already QC'ed OK
 -- are not pulled up again
 
 --
 
 --- added for the LT 2018
 begin
 select nvl(number_of_prods,total_bags_in_set) into nBags from valid_catalogs where catalog_number=temp_catalog_number and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+100);
 
 exception when others then
 nBags:=3; -- check with BA if the 3 is OK or not. This 3 here is based on our assumption.
 end; 
 
 temp_no_of_bags:=nBags+temp_no_of_bags;
 
 --- addition is over for teh LT 2018
 
 
 begin
 if temp_qc_label_flag = 'Y'
 then
 clear_record;
 goto next_unit;
 end if;
 end;
 --
 -- Make sure that QC for labeling is restricted to
 -- only domestic collection units and imported units
 --
 begin
 select contract_type
 into temp_contract_type
 from contracts
 where contract_id = temp_contract_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id;
 if temp_contract_id != 'INTERNAL' and
 temp_contract_type != 'IM'
 then
 clear_record;
 goto next_unit;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from contracts');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Check for required Testing
 --
 -- Check if there are profile tests required for
 -- labeling not done even once
 --
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 begin
 
 select 'N' into :testing_flag
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = temp_contract_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 stop_label_flag = 'Y' and
 v_local_date between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, v_local_date+365) and
 not exists
 (select 'x'
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 utrs.test_id = contract_tests.test_id and
 result_status_2 is null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 cancel_flag is null
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 unit_test_base.test_id =
 contract_tests.test_id and
 result_status_2 is null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 cancel_flag is null);
 goto testing_faulty;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :testing_flag := 'Y';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :testing_flag := 'N';
 goto testing_faulty;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from contract_tests');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :testing_flag := nvl(:testing_flag,'Y');
 --
 -- Check for initial interdictions, and incomplete
 -- testing (ie. no result for test_seq_no != 1. If
 -- found assign 'I' to testing_flag. JMC 03-21-95
 --
 if (:testing_flag = 'Y') then
 begin
 select 'I' into :testing_flag from contract_tests
 where contract_id = temp_contract_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 stop_label_flag = 'Y' and
 v_local_date between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,v_local_date+365) and
 exists (select 'x' from utrs u
 where u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 u.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 u.test_id = contract_tests.test_id and
 u.test_seq_no != '1' and
 u.result_status_1 is null and
 u.cancel_flag is null and
 exists (select 'X' from unit_interdictions x
 where x.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(x.coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and x.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id
 and x.source_test_id = u.test_id
 and exists (select 'X' from valid_interdictions_lab v
 where v.inter_code = x.inter_code and
 v.inter_type = 'I'))
 union select 'x' from unit_test_base utb
 where utb.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(utb.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 utb.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 utb.test_id = contract_tests.test_id and
 utb.test_seq_no != '1' and
 utb.result_status_1 is null and
 utb.cancel_flag is null and
 exists (select 'x' from unit_interdictions x
 where x.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(x.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 x.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 x.source_test_id = utb.test_id and
 exists (select 'x' from valid_interdictions_lab v
 where v.inter_code = x.inter_code and
 v.inter_type = 'I')));
 goto testing_faulty;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 :testing_flag := 'Y';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 :testing_flag := 'I';
 goto testing_faulty;
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in selecting from contract_tests');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 <<testing_faulty>>
 --
 -- Check for nursing audit; First check if it is
 -- required and then set the flag
 --
 if :GLOBAL.chapter_nursing_flag = 'N'
 then
 begin
 select nvl(nursing_flag,'N')
 into :GLOBAL.drive_nursing_flag
 from drives_lab dl, units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 units.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 trunc(units.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 dl.drive_id = units.drive_id and
 dl.chapter_id = units.chapter_id;
 end;
 if :GLOBAL.drive_nursing_flag = 'N'
 then
 temp_nursing_audit_reqd := 'N';
 else
 temp_nursing_audit_reqd := 'Y';
 end if;
 else
 temp_nursing_audit_reqd := 'Y';
 end if;
 if temp_nursing_audit_reqd = 'Y'
 then
 :unit_nursing_audit_flag := temp_nursing_audit_flag;
 else
 :unit_nursing_audit_flag := '*';
 end if;
 if :component_review is null
 then
 --
 -- Check if the number of components defined equals
 -- the number of bags
 --
 begin
 select sum(nvl(bags_used,1))
 into temp_no_of_comp
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date);
 if temp_no_of_comp = temp_no_of_bags
 then
 :component_review := 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :component_review := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 /*else
 :s_dummy8 := '***'; */
 end if;
 if :donor_interface = 'Y' and
 :testing_flag in ('Y','I') and
 :unit_nursing_audit_flag in ('Y','*') and
 :component_review = 'Y'
 then
 :qc_label_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 <<next_unit>>
 if :system.trigger_record = '1' and
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id is null
 then
 null;
 else
 :s_sl_no := :system.trigger_record;
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
v_local_time date;
v_local_date date;

begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 first_record;
 

if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 loop
 if :qc_label_flag is not null
 then
 begin
 update units
 set qc_label_flag = :qc_label_flag,
 qc_label_date = v_local_date,
 component_review_flag = :component_review,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 then
 down;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and cancel_flag is null;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_tests := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_tests := 'N';
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and cancel_flag is null;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_temp_tests := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_temp_tests := 'N';
 end if;
 end;
 :GLOBAL.field_left := :system.cursor_field;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_no_tests = 'Y' and
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_temp_tests = 'Y'
 then
 show_error('0204');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('ctrl_blk_2.unit_id','bold-underline');
 if :GLOBAL.unit_no_temp_tests = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('utrs');
 execute_query;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UTRS.TEST_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'UTRS.TEST_ID', UPDATE_NULL, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 :system.message_level := 0;
 go_block('utrs');
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_no_tests = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('unit_test_base');
 execute_query;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UNIT_TEST_BASE.TEST_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'UNIT_TEST_BASE.TEST_ID', UPDATE_NULL, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 :system.message_level := 0;
 go_block('unit_test_base');
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_no_temp_tests = 'N' and
 :GLOBAL.unit_no_tests = 'N'
 then
 go_block('utrs');
 execute_query;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UTRS.TEST_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'UTRS.TEST_ID', UPDATE_NULL, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 :system.message_level := 0;
 go_block('utrs');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_TB_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select test_batch_det.tb_id, test_batch_det.test_chapter_id, to_char(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset,insert_dats),'MM-DD-YY') from test_batch_det, test_batch_hdr where test_id = 'ABORH' and nvl(reconcile_flag,'Y') != 'D' and test_batch_det.tb_id = test_batch_hdr.tb_id and to_date(to_char(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset,insert_dats),'mmddyy'),'mmddyy') between (to_date(to_char(trunc(:CTRL_BLK_1.LOCALSYSDATE-21),'mmddyy'),'mmddyy')) and (to_date(to_char(:CTRL_BLK_1.LOCALSYSDATE,'mmddyy'),'mmddyy')) 
AND insert_dats between :CTRL_BLK_1.LOCALSYSDATE-23 AND :CTRL_BLK_1.LOCALSYSDATE+2 and exists (select 'x' from utrs where utrs.tb_id = test_batch_det.tb_id and utrs.test_chapter_id = test_batch_det.test_chapter_id and utrs.cancel_flag is null and utrs.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and exists (select 'x' from units where units.unit_id = utrs.unit_id and units.coll_date = utrs.coll_date and units.chapter_id = utrs.chapter_id and nvl(qc_label_flag,'N') != 'Y')) order by insert_dats desc
